module_summary: Traffic light controller with 3-state FSM, countdown timer, and registered light outputs.

anchors.name: state
anchors.why: FSM controller state register; transitions idle/red/yellow/green based on timer.

anchors.name: cnt
anchors.why: Countdown timer; loaded per state and decrements to trigger transitions.

anchors.name: red
anchors.why: Red light output; driven by p_red register.

anchors.name: yellow
anchors.why: Yellow light output; driven by p_yellow register.

anchors.name: green
anchors.why: Green light output; driven by p_green register.

anchors.name: p_red
anchors.why: Holds next red value; FSM-decoded output before output register.

anchors.name: p_yellow
anchors.why: Holds next yellow value; FSM-decoded output before output register.

anchors.name: p_green
anchors.why: Holds next green value; FSM-decoded output before output register.

anchors.name: clock
anchors.why: Timer value output; direct assignment of cnt for external observation.

anchors.name: pass_request
anchors.why: Request signal; gates early transition when green and request asserted.

groups.name: FSM Controller
groups.description: State register and countdown timer managing light transitions.

groups.name: Light Outputs
groups.description: Output registers and intermediate holds for red/yellow/green lights.

groups.name: Status and Control
groups.description: Timer output and external request input.
